item.title: ECCE 2026 - European Conference on Cognitive Ergonomics
item.content:encoded:
Stefano Guidi, University of Siena

Oronzo Parlangeli, University of Siena

Paola Palmitesta, University of Siena

The special issue will feature a selection of the best papers accepted for the European Conference on Cognitive Ergonomics 2026 (ECCE 2026). The authors of the 6 best long papers submitted to the conference will be invited to submit their paper which will undergo a review process.

Potential topics

  • Cognitive ergonomics research presented at ECCE 2026

Timeline

  • August 14, 2026: Manuscript deadline
